report.title: Todo command doesn't work in some desktop browsers
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.25.3

### Bug Description

When i use `/todo` command it doesn't work in most **desktop** browsers.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. In Google Сhrome browser open a note in edit mode
2. Press `/` in the very beginning of an empty line
3. Press enter while `/todo` is highlighted

### Expected

`- [ ] ` to appear

### Actual

The line remains empty

### Additional Context

**Client envs**:
- Desktop Google Chrome browser
- Desktop Firefox browser
- Desktop Brave browser

**Notes**:
1. The feature works when the line is not empty.
2. The feature works as expected in Android Chrome browser

# Todo command doesn't work in some desktop browsers

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.
Verify the sign-in form is gone and the memo app's main page is shown.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:16214/.
Stay on localhost:16214 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Click the memo editor on the home page to focus it
2. Make sure the cursor is at the very beginning of an empty line
3. Press the / key
4. Wait for the slash-command menu to appear with todo highlighted
5. Press Enter while the todo option is highlighted
The reporter says the correct behavior is that The editor's empty line shows the text '- [ ] ' after selecting the todo command, and the slash-command menu is closed. Verify that The editor's empty line shows the text '- [ ] ' after selecting the todo command, and the slash-command menu is closed.

verdict.headline: Pressing Enter on the highlighted /todo command left the command menu open instead of inserting the todo text.
verdict.root_cause: The editor did not apply the selected todo command when Enter was pressed, so the requested todo line was not created and the menu remained visible.
verdict.suggested_fix: Fix the Enter handling for the highlighted /todo menu item so it replaces the slash command with '- [ ] ' and closes the menu.
